sloka: दत्त्वा तु सह वैदेह्या ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनम् बहु ।जग्मतुः पितरम् द्रष्टुम् सीतया सह राघवौ ॥२-३३-१॥
transliteration: dattvā tu saha vaidehyā brāhmaṇebhyo dhanam bahu ।jagmatuḥ pitaram draṣṭum sītayā saha rāghavau ॥2-33-1॥

translations.english: After giving away plenty of wealth to brahmins in charity, Rama and Lakshmana along with Sita set out to see their father, king Dasaratha.
